period_note: Year-end position from the Annual Report 2011's own audited Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, Solo basis. This bank has had a subsidiary (Premier Bank Securities Ltd, incorporated June 2010) since before this period, so both Solo and Consolidated statements exist for FY2011; Solo is used per project convention. IMPORTANT: this report's own compact 'Performance Highlights for Five Years 2007-2011' summary table (which most other years' data in this series draw from) was independently proven to be CONSOLIDATED basis for total assets/deposits/loans/income-statement rows (e.g. its Interest Income 7,417.02 and Profit after Tax 510.90 match the Consolidated P&L exactly, not the Solo P&L's 7,222.84 and 461.19) - so those rows were NOT used here; Solo figures were pulled directly from the audited Solo Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account instead. However, the SAME table's Capital Strength section (Tier-I/Tier-II/Total Capital/CAR%) was independently cross-verified against this report's own 'Disclosures on Risk Based Capital Adequacy (Basel II)' note (explicitly titled 'The Premier Bank Limited', excluding the subsidiary) and matches closely (Tier-1 648.74 crore = Tk.6,487.4m vs table's 6,487.35; Tier-2 80.38 crore = Tk.803.8m vs table's 803.83; Total Capital 729.12 crore = Tk.7,291.2m vs table's 7,291.19) - confirming Capital Strength rows in that table are genuinely Solo despite the balance-sheet rows being Consolidated. NPL volume (2,132.34) and % (4.28%) are taken from the same table; recomputing against this JSON's Solo gross loans (50,101.11) gives 4.26%, a 0.02pp gap attributable to a different (consolidated) loans denominator in the original 4.28% - immaterial, reported value kept. EPS (1.21) and ROE/ROA (calculated, not table-reported) use Solo profit after tax over Solo equity/assets, since the table's own EPS (1.34) and ROE (7.66%)/ROA (0.68%) are Consolidated-basis (verified: 510.90/6,673.41=7.66%). Reserve fund = Statutory reserve + Other reserve (excludes retained earnings, per project convention). Total liabilities is directly reported (not derived).
